label: 梅 Calm Grid (standard)
add: CALM GRID / STANDARD: preserve the standard-plan base geometry. Use clean navy and white curved panels, restrained blue-purple indirect lighting, a clear rear-wall presentation screen, and an orderly calm grid rhythm. Keep all three open sides unobstructed.

label: 竹 Luminous Membrane (premium)
add: LUMINOUS MEMBRANE / PREMIUM: color and finish the premium-plan base geometry in place. The three oval luminous membrane reliefs are fixed to the rear wall; keep their exact positions and sizes. Apply white membrane texture, warm timber accents, plants, and blue-purple light lines only to shapes already present in the base image. Do not add a lantern, pendant, suspended element, hanging sign, truss, canopy, fascia, or any new structure. Keep all three open sides unobstructed.

label: 松 Infinite Flow (impact)
add: INFINITE FLOW / IMPACT: preserve the impact-plan base geometry. Express a dynamic but buildable blue-to-purple flow with the compact infinity feature entirely inside the 3.6 m envelope and footprint. Keep all three open sides unobstructed. The infinity artwork is at most 2.4 m wide and 2.0 m high, behind the entrance aisle; it must not become a gate or touch any beam. Preserve the small base-image feature.
